fix(profile): never delete the default or hardened profile

Redmine: 49381

`coi profile delete` checked only `Source == "(built-in)"`. A disk `default` profile (`.coi/profiles/default/` or `~/.coi/profiles/default/`) replaces the built-in one and has a real path, so `coi profile delete default` removed the whole directory. `coi profile delete hardened` said `'default'` in its error.

Behaviour change: `default` and `hardened` are now always refused, whatever their source. For a disk profile, the error names its directory and says to remove it by hand. The built-in error names the profile. CHANGELOG `[Breaking]`, and the command help says so.

The built-in names have one source: `builtinProfiles` in `internal/config/defaults.go`. `Load` injects from it, and `config.IsBuiltinProfile` is the delete guard.

Tests
- Go `internal/cli/profile_delete_test.go`: both names, built-in and disk (the directory survives), and a normal disk profile is still removed. Fails on `master`.
- Go `internal/config` `TestIsBuiltinProfile`.
- `tests/cli/test_profile_crud.py`: built-in `hardened`, disk `default` (user and project), disk `hardened`. CLI-only, no Incus: run locally against this build (24/24 pass) and against `master` (the 4 new tests fail).

Verification: gofmt, go vet, golangci-lint (0 issues), `go test -short -race ./...`, ruff, `check-ci-coverage.py`. Other integration lanes: CI only (no Incus in the sandbox).

fix: [PSUPCLCAP-5876] Add an ability to select shell for commands

None

fix(execstat): count the snapshot forks and drop the stale CLI-only exemption (#3912)

## 摘要
關 #3912（WWD-9 9b-2 的 codex R2 發現的既有缺口）：`internal/execstat/guard_test.go` 的 `cliOnly` 表把 `internal/wwd/snapshot/worktree.go` 豁免成「只在 CLI 行程裡跑」，理由是「SnapshotTree is called only by RunAssist」。W1 把 `SnapshotTree` 搬進 `internal/wwd/snapshot` 之後這句話就不成立：`cmd/wwd/qualifysource.go:102` → `submit.Prepare` → `internal/wwd/submit/submit.go:146` → `snapshot.SnapshotTree`，是 **wwd daemon** 的路徑。cliOnly 是整檔豁免，所以 `worktree.go` 的 fork 不進 daemon 的 execstat、守門測試也不會擋。

改了下列幾處（兩個 commit）：
- `internal/wwd/snapshot/worktree.go:48`：`exec.CommandContext` → `execstat.CommandContext(ctx, "wwd.snapshot-tree", …)`（tag 命名照同套件 `materialize.go` 的 `wwd.snapshot-*`）；`os/exec` import 換成 `internal/execstat`。
- `internal/execstat/guard_test.go`：刪 `cliOnly` 裡 `worktree.go` 那一列。
- **第二個同類的過時豁免（codex R2 發現，commit ee89ef298）**：`cliOnly` 把 `cmd/pdx/reap_children.go` 標成「`pdx gate`: reaps what its command left」，但 `runServe`（`cmd/pdx/main.go:144-147`）在 daemon 每次啟動或 reexec 都呼叫 `reapInheritedChildren`，其中 `directChildren`（`reap_children.go:91`）用 `exec.CommandContext` 啟動 `ps`，是 daemon 的 fork。改成 `execstat.CommandContext(ctx, "pdx.reap-ps", …)`，並刪那一列。`execstat.Cmd` 的 `Run` 是 Start 接 Wait，`ps` 仍由 os/exec 自己回收，不會被之後的 `wait4(-1)` 搶走（critic 核對 `tagged.go:288-294,346-361,403-409`）。

這個檔只有這一處 fork（同套件 `git.go:83` 已經走 `execstat.CommandContext`）。行為不變：`*execstat.Cmd` 內嵌 `*exec.Cmd`，`Env`／`Stdin`／`Stdout`／`Stderr`／`Run` 都照舊，只多記一筆計數。

## 測試
- 紅綠：只刪 `worktree.go` 那一列、不改程式 → `TestEveryForkInTheDaemonGoesThroughTheHelpers` 紅（`worktree.go: exec.CommandContext at x.go:48:10`）；加上程式修正 → 綠。`reap_children.go` 同理改完後該守門測試綠，`reap_children_test.go` 四個測試（Collects／NeverBlocks／SurvivorIsCollected／ListingFailure）本機單檔通過。
- PR 層 head `b6f2f2f4c`（第一個 commit）：go-changed ./internal/wwd/snapshot/ ./internal/execstat/ ./cmd/wwd/ j_01M5EKG5YVE9B36V0NWRDTHNEA 通過；lint j_01M5EKG7NTYF0XXRV3XFA9588A 通過。
- PR 層 head `ee89ef298`：go-changed ./internal/wwd/snapshot/ ./internal/execstat/ ./cmd/wwd/ ./cmd/pdx/... j_01M5EKR1KRM50H48A1SSNGS3WN（見下方留言）；lint j_01M5EKR2TKJQNF33JVREA7YAE0 通過。

## codex
| 輪 | job | 結果 |
|---|---|---|
| R1 | review-mvhr4j32-aqocre | 無缺陷（針對第一個 commit） |
| R2 攻擊 | review-mvhr5zpn-99n36w | 1 條 medium：`reap_children.go` 的過時 CLI-only 豁免 → 已修（ee89ef298） |
| R2 critic | review-mvhr9tbi-s7qspo | approve：finding 成立、修法正確、無等待競態、cliOnly 剩餘各列都有 CLI 分派證據、pending 為空，未找到第三個錯誤豁免 |

 | Guessing a join code | A join code has eight characters from an alphabet of 32, about 1.1e12 codes, and a wrong code is answered like any unknown class before a password is hashed. The row of a used token stays until its session reaches `JWT_SESSION_MAX_DAYS` days after the sign in, 90 by default, so a token that was stolen and used long ago still ends the session when its owner shows it, and the event is logged with the owner. A replay within a minute of the use is only refused. After `JWT_SESSION_MAX_DAYS` days the session ends by itself, so a stolen token cannot keep it alive for ever. A revived Redis cannot make a used token valid again | [Redis is optional](design.md#redis-is-optional) |

 | Reading or starting a chat that is not yours | A conversation answers `404` to anyone who is not one of its two people, or a member of the class of a room, so the answer does not tell whether it exists. A member of a room reads only the messages sent after they joined, and the mark of a read position stops at the newest message they can see. A photo or video is stored in a bucket that is never public and is read through a signed address that is made for each answer. The key of an upload is accepted only for the account and the conversation that asked for it, so a key of another account, another conversation or another file is refused before the bucket is asked about it. A new direct conversation needs one teacher and one parent who share an active class, and a room needs one member of the class, and an id that belongs to nobody, to a deleted account or to the same role gets the same `403` as a person without a shared class. A message is written under a lock on its conversation, so the ids cannot skip. A person who no longer shares a class keeps the history and loses sending | `internal/app/chat` and the end to end test of the chat |

Bump Go to 1.26.10 to fix crypto/x509 vulnerability

## ClickUp Ticket

**ClickUp Ticket ID:** DUPLOAI-4459

## Type

<!-- Check exactly one type that best describes this PR -->
- [ ] `enhancement` — New feature or improvement
- [x] `bug` — Bug fix
- [ ] `breaking-change` — Breaking change
- [ ] `documentation` — Documentation only

## Overview

Bumps Go to 1.26.10 so govulncheck passes again after stdlib advisory GO-2026-6809.

## Summary of changes

This PR does the following:

- Bump the `go` directive in `go.mod` from 1.26.9 to 1.26.10, which contains the patched `crypto/x509` (GO-2026-6809).
- CI (`setup-go` with `go-version-file: go.mod`) now installs 1.26.10, unblocking the govulncheck job on open PRs such as #252.

- [ ] Using acceptance tests (`TF_ACC=1`)
- [x] Manually, on my local system (`go build ./...` and `govulncheck ./...`: No vulnerabilities found)
- [ ] Manually, on a remote test system

None.
